summary.text: Ryan Berman is the Republican candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Sean Carlson in a race without an incumbent.
Berman is an attorney who represented District 39 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Berman was a member of the Michigan House of Representatives, representing District 39, from January 1, 2019, until January 1, 2023, succeeding Klint Kesto.
He did not run for re-election in 2022, and Pauline Wendzel succeeded him.
In the 2019-2020 term, Berman's committee assignments were Regulatory Reform, where he was majority vice chair, Financial Services, Judiciary and Insurance.
In 2021-2022, he served on the Energy, Insurance, Judiciary, Local Government and Municipal Finance, and Transportation committees, and was majority vice chair of Insurance.
Berman advanced from the Republican primary for the Senate seat on August 4, 2026, as the only candidate on the ballot.
